name: Drink Wholesome Egg White Protein Powder (Vanilla)
whyItWorks: Formulated specifically for individuals with IBD, IBS, and sensitive stomachs. Made with only egg whites, chickpeas/coconut, monk fruit, and vanilla bean—zero gums, emulsifiers, artificial flavors, or sugar alcohols.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake or blend 1 scoop with 8-10 oz water or plant milk.
